description: CCP load balancing and TDMA vectors with independent math oracles (hash_32, drift calc from spec).

vectors.name: tdma_slot_assignment_static_hash
vectors.description: Canonical slot at SFN zero from (FNV-1a32(EUI64) + u32(SFN)) mod num_slots. Independent external arithmetic oracle.

vectors.name: guard_time_boundary_sf10
vectors.description: The 2346ms SF10 maximum-frame slot retains its 50ms guard under 0.5% drift over a 5s superframe.

vectors.name: drift_compensation_two_beacons
vectors.description: Offset correction from beacon arrival times for clock drift compensation.

vectors.name: ccp_load_high_util_rebalance
vectors.description: Load score triggers channel rebalance and TDMA slot reassignment when util>0.4.

vectors.name: select_channel_timing_now_near_wrap
vectors.description: select_channel via hash_32(now() ^ iid) with now near u32 wrap, 8 channels. Independent FNV-1a32 oracle per spec/02a-coordinated-capacity.md.

vectors.name: select_channel_timing_now_zero
vectors.description: select_channel via hash_32(now() ^ iid) with now=0 (epoch start), 8 channels. Independent FNV-1a32 oracle.

vectors.name: select_channel_timing_now_mid
vectors.description: select_channel via hash_32(now() ^ iid) with mid-range now=12345678, 8 channels. Independent FNV-1a32 oracle.
